newsitem.title: USA: Trump debt enriched by Colony investment.
newsitem.headline: Trump debt enriched by Colony investment.

text.p: Colony Capital Inc's proposed $125 million equity investment in Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc came as a boon to bondholders on Monday, traders and analysts said.

News of the deal sent Trump Castle's debt up more than 10 points amid thin activity in the broad market, high-yield traders said. The notes traded as high as 96 before settling at 93, a gain of 11 points from Friday's close.

"This equity infusion is a very encouraging development and bonds have traded up accordingly," said a gaming sector analyst at a Wall Street investment bank, adding that the move was not anticipated by the Street.
The Colony investment will feature the purchase of a 51 percent equity interest in Trump Castle. Proceeds will be used to fund expansion and retheming of Trump Castle to Trump Marina, Trump said.
Trump said it signed a letter of intent to form the partnership with Colony.

The move comes seven weeks after Trump and the Rank Group Plc broke off talks that would have resulted in the retheming of Trump Castle into a Hard Rock Casino Hotel. Rank had proposed a $50 million investment in Trump Castle.
Trump's Atlantic City Funding notes rose more than three points to 96 bid. The notes traded as high as 97-3/4, according to one high-yield trader.
Trump shares rose 1-5/8 to 11-3/4 at midday.
